scope: Exactly four additional train-only full-source photos; no resizing/cropping into separate samples, no detector outputs used.

images.reviewMethod: Tool-displayed original-size complete image; no learned predictions.
images.observation: Natural close-up of unthreaded round metal bars. Visible tan/brown cut faces are continuous solids, with rough/saw-cut texture and dark mottling; blue-gray shafts have patchy surface coloration. No discernible pipe mouth. Some edge-cut faces are only partially in frame.
images.textureCaveat: Dark surface chemistry cannot be identified from photograph alone.

images.reviewMethod: Tool-displayed original-size complete image; no learned predictions.
images.observation: Photographed stockpile of round metal bars with continuous red-brown cut faces, saw grooves and irregular darker patches. The dark interstitial gaps are between separate bars, not pipe interiors. No discernible pipe mouth.
images.textureCaveat: Red/dark finish may include industrial paint or oxidation; do not label it chemically verified rust.

images.reviewMethod: Tool-displayed original-size complete image; no learned predictions.
images.observation: Warehouse scene of round steel bar bundles. Dark flat cut faces remain visibly continuous; chalk digits and circular labels occur on several faces. No discernible pipe mouth.
images.textureCaveat: This is a solid-end / painted-mark confuser, not an oxide-only sample. Original available source photo is 500x500.

images.reviewMethod: Tool-displayed original-size complete image; no learned predictions.

images.textureCaveat: Only visible discoloration is claimed; oxide, paint and oil cannot be distinguished. Previously downloaded but never admitted reserve photo.
